subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

A shiver of fear ran _________ me when the lights went out.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"through" **is used to indicate movement from one side or end to another.
 
• In this context,** it correctly describes the sensation of fear moving within the person.**
 
• Other options such as "above", "about", and "to" do not fit the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A shiver of fear ran **through **me when the lights went out."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "above" is used to indicate a higher position and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3:** "about" can mean concerning or around, which does not suit the context here.
 
• **Option 4:** "to" indicates direction or destination and is not appropriate in this context.
